“到底发生什么事了，我们检测到贫瘠高原方向爆发超大规模的能量暴动……这……”卡门脸色有些不自然。
“就是你想的那样.......这股能量爆发的位置，就是真实地狱深渊……所以我们要做好最坏的打算。”
澎湃的能量从深渊下面喷涌而出，同样升起的还有一根根丝线，这些丝线后面，连接的是无数恶魔傀儡。
“不行，那里的干扰和冲击太强烈，这是我能看到的最大程度。”绿野的声音还有些虚弱。
“你太冒险了。星徒带她回文明长阶，另外，通知告诉其他超维，开拓新世界的计划暂缓。”

"What happened? We detected a large-scale energy riot in the direction of the barren plateau... This..." Carmen's face looked a little unnatural.
"It's just what you think...the location where this energy explodes is the real abyss of hell...so we have to prepare for the worst."
Surging energy gushes out from under the abyss, and also rises up with threads. Behind these threads, connected are countless demon puppets.
"No, the interference and impact there are too strong. This is the maximum level I can see." Luye's voice was still a little weak.
"You are taking too many risks. The Star Disciple will take her back to the Long Stage of Civilization. In addition, the notice will tell other super dimensions that the plan to open up a new world is suspended."
